entry.title: Kimi Code v2.6.2 — 5 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD [providers."<id>"] — a custom-registry (api.json) entry can declare optional search_url / feedback_url fields for WebSearch and /feedback
  • CHG /feedback — the text-only “No attachment” option is gone; it now shows the session’s files before confirmation and includes the session’s request_id
  • FIX Multi-second loading delays reopening long sessions, extending the 2.6.1 fix to sessions with many tool calls
  • FIX Ctrl-V — a failed or unfinished Kimi media upload is now rejected instead of being cached as an unusable file reference
  • FIX /swarm — fixed the panel missing live subagent updates during execution

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.6.1 — 2 placemat changes
entry.content:
• FIX Multi-second loading delays reopening long sessions
  • FIX /compact — long sessions no longer stall with an empty reply instead of auto-compacting when tool results carry notes, errors, or timing headers

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.6.0 — 10 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD [transcript].tool_call_density / [transcript].thinking — fullscreen mode folds consecutive tool calls and thinking into summary lines by default and hides Activated skill cards for model-loaded skills; set either to "ungrouped", or adjust folding in /settings, to keep the previous layout
  • ADD @ file-path completion now includes hidden and .gitignore-ignored paths by default, ranking non-ignored matches first at equal match quality
  • ADD Same-name workspace Skills now stay individually selectable in a dedicated picker group, labelled by directory, global, or built-in source
  • ADD Fullscreen mode — Ctrl-C / Cmd-C copies selected text; toggle with Copy on select in /settings
  • CHG [[permission.rules]] — user and trusted project rules are now persisted and reapplied automatically whenever a session starts, including in print mode, with deny still taking precedence over ask and allow
  • ADD [background] — Tower now tracks artifact missions with key-deliverable review and human acceptance, shown in status and mission views
  • CHG [secondary_model] — primary can be listed again as an ordinary pool alias; Tower reviewers now use the pool default instead of the main model
  • ADD KIMI_CODE_CLIPBOARD_OSC52 — outside SSH and mosh, only the system clipboard is used by default; set to 1 to also send OSC 52
  • ADD KIMI_CODE_TUI_ANIMATION_FPS — adjust the frame rate of in-progress title shimmer animations
  • FIX --environment <id> — the local environment’s default workdir now follows the current primary directory after a primary swap; pass an explicit --environment-cwd to keep the previous pinned-directory behavior

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.5.3 — 2 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG Ctrl-S — steering now interrupts an active model request immediately and continues in the same turn, instead of waiting for the next interruptible point
  • FIX mcp.json — fixed stdio servers configured with script commands such as npx failing to start on Windows

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.5.2 — 1 placemat change
entry.content: • FIX [mcp] default_deferred — fixed duplicate tool declaration errors in select_tools when MCP tool definitions change

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.5.1 — 1 placemat change
entry.content: • FIX /sessions — sessions belonging to deleted workspaces no longer appear in the list

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.5.0 — 7 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD Switching the model while the agent is working — the change applies from the next turn; a turn that already started calling the model keeps its own settings
  • ADD [environments] / --environment <id> / --environment-cwd <path> — create sessions whose tools run on a configured SSH, Docker, or custom-launcher remote environment
  • ADD Project-level Skills now merge across every configured source directory instead of only the primary one; the primary directory still wins name conflicts
  • ADD [workspace] require_trust — set to false to treat every workspace as trusted and skip the startup trust prompt; takes effect on /reload
  • CHG [secondary_model] force — now ignored with a warning; a lone default_model already pins every subagent to it, and the pool no longer offers an implicit primary choice — list the main model explicitly to use it
  • CHG [database] global_search — now defaults to false; the full-text search index does not build and POST /api/v1/search reports it unavailable until enabled (KIMI_CODE_GLOBAL_SEARCH)
  • ADD /fork — can now fork a still-running session, and fork from a selected historical turn instead of only the latest

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.4.1 — 2 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG [read] max_chars — a single file read now returns at most 100,000 characters (~25,000 tokens) by default, down from 500,000; raise both limits here
  • CHG Shrank built-in tool and subagent prompts, including repeated goal and plan-mode reminders

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.4.0 — 12 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /import-sessions / kimi import-sessions — import Claude Code and Codex sessions from the last 15 or 30 days
  • ADD /provider refresh [providerId] — re-fetches one provider’s model list, or every provider’s with no argument
  • CHG Ctrl-O — also expands or collapses streaming thinking output
  • ADD main-session and subagent status reporting to compatible terminals via OSC 7501, including pending interactions and retained results
  • CHG Tower (experimental) — supports per-task model selection and reuses max_running_tasks as a combined worker/reviewer cap; raises the default agent concurrency from 16 to 256
  • ADD [mcp] reconnect_initial_delay_ms / reconnect_max_delay_ms (and the matching KIMI_MCP_RECONNECT_INITIAL_DELAY_MS / KIMI_MCP_RECONNECT_MAX_DELAY_MS env vars) — workspace MCP servers now reconnect automatically with backoff after a dropped or failed connection
  • CHG Plan mode can now only be enabled by the user, not entered automatically by the agent; every plan requires review
  • CHG Never Ask — no longer auto-approves plans
  • CHG -p, --prompt — now skips default_plan_mode and cannot approve a plan when the session is already in Plan mode
  • CHG Fullscreen UI — improved approval-option display, mouse selection, and focus switching
  • DEL Ctrl-T and the old input-area todo panel — removed; todo lists now live in expandable transcript cards
  • CHG /import-from-cc-codex skill improved

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.3.3 — 4 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG /swarm — turning swarm mode on now shows a high-usage warning
  • FIX AgentSwarm — rejecting a call before any subagent starts (such as while swarm mode is off) no longer shows as a failed swarm; the agent now points to /swarm instead
  • CHG /model — reworded the model switch confirmation prompts
  • CHG swarm/goal start confirmation — merged the two repeated permission-mode notice lines into one sentence each

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.3.2 — 2 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG Agent — handles tasks directly by default instead of proactively launching subagents; delegation now needs an explicit request in your message, AGENTS.md, a skill, or an enabled multi-agent mode
  • CHG AgentSwarm — the agent can no longer launch it on its own; swarms now start only when swarm mode is turned on, so they’re unavailable in kimi -p or ACP clients such as Zed

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.3.1 — 4 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD KIMI_CODE_SESSION_LOCK — set to 0 to turn off the cross-process lock that stops two processes writing the same session
  • CHG /sessions / /resume — after a retry, offers to take over a session still held by an exited process; session-in-use errors name the holding client
  • FIX sessions occasionally remaining occupied after an application crash on macOS and Linux
  • FIX workspace trust prompt — no longer fails when Git Bash is unavailable on Windows

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.3.0 — 8 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD auto_session_title — auto-generates a session title after the first turn and shows it as the terminal window title; a global config.toml gate and an independent tui.toml opt-out
  • ADD [mcp] default_deferred — defaults every MCP server’s tools to on-demand loading when the experimental tool-select flag is on
  • CHG /model — switching models mid-session with history can show a confirmation dialog, gated by cloud configuration
  • CHG /compact — now queues while the agent is busy instead of failing with an error
  • CHG /skill:<name> — plugin skills are listed and invoked only under their qualified plugin-id:skill-name form; a bare plugin-skill name no longer resolves
  • CHG disable_feedback_survey — moved from tui.toml to config.toml
  • CHG [permission].dangerous_command_guard — set to false now disables every built-in guard, not only the dangerous-command check
  • FIX [[hooks]] — hook commands now run in the session’s project directory instead of the server’s startup directory

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.2.0 — 10 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD kimi app [path] — opens a new desktop chat in the current or a given directory; needs a desktop app version that supports it
  • ADD KIMI_CODE_TRUST_WORKSPACE — marks the current workspace as trusted for this process, like the interactive trust prompt
  • CHG Ctrl-P / Ctrl-N Updates panel — now shows opt-in mid-turn progress updates, off by default and toggled from /experiments
  • CHG Ctrl-S — also sends a highlighted skill prompt, replacing the old skill-suggestion cards
  • CHG tui_mode fullscreen — a scrolled-out user message gets a sticky one-line summary; clicking it jumps back to the original message
  • CHG [background] — the agent’s in-turn wait for a task is capped at 90 seconds and discourages repeated waits; a new message ends the wait early
  • CHG Ctrl-C — forces an immediate exit during shutdown hooks instead of waiting for the hook timeout; a “Shutting down” hint shows meanwhile
  • FIX UserPromptSubmit hook — fixed turn ordering and rendering when the hook injects text; hook JSON without a message field is no longer added to the conversation
  • FIX forked sessions — cron tasks from the source session no longer fire inside a fork
  • DEL executor = "kaos" — removed from MCP stdio configuration (never implemented); configs using it now fail validation at load time

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.1.0–v2.1.1 — 7 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD tui_mode (/settings → TUI mode) — experimental fullscreen TUI layout; click a folded block to toggle it, with a clickable “Jump to bottom” indicator
  • DEL KIMI_CODE_TUI_FULL_SCREEN — removed now that fullscreen is a tui_mode setting instead of an env flag
  • ADD KIMI_CODE_REPEAT_BREAKER — set to 0 to stop reminders and forced stops for repeated tool calls
  • CHG [workspace].additional_dir — rejects directories that resolve to the home directory or filesystem root
  • FIX hardened workspace security: file tools can no longer escape the working directory via symlinks, project-local config only applies once the workspace is trusted, and background git operations can no longer run commands from repository git config
  • CHG reduced the CLI’s startup time and memory usage
  • CHG [watch] / KIMI_CODE_WATCH — briefly defaulted to off in 2.1.0; reverted to on by default in 2.1.1

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.0.2 — 4 placemat changes
entry.content:
• FIX /resume — new messages no longer land at an old position in the conversation after resuming a session
  • FIX /compact — no longer fails after switching to a model with a smaller context window
  • CHG the agent no longer assumes the current working directory is the project root
  • FIX a message sent while the agent was running no longer sometimes appears twice in the chat

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.0.1 — 5 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD [watch] / KIMI_CODE_WATCH — disable filesystem watchers for local.toml, AGENTS.md, skills and MCP config entirely
  • CHG [providers."<id>"] — api_key_env names an environment variable to read the API key from, as an alternative to api_key
  • ADD [database] — searchSyncSessionCap / searchSyncDebounceMs tune the incremental background search-sync pass (marked unverified — not yet in the config reference)
  • CHG /yolo / -y, --yolo — Ask When Needed no longer prompts for a Bash command that cannot be statically analyzed
  • CHG kimi install-app — renamed to kimi install-desktop; the old name keeps working as a hidden alias

entry.title: Kimi Code v2.0.0 — 3 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /desktop / /install-desktop — opens the Kimi Code desktop app page in your browser
  • ADD kimi install-app — prints and opens the desktop app page (renamed to kimi install-desktop in 2.0.1)
  • ADD [markdown].mermaid — renders fenced mermaid code blocks in the terminal as diagrams (marked unverified — not yet in the config reference)

entry.title: Kimi Code v0.43.1 — 2 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG /copy — native clipboard write path for Linux X11 sessions
  • FIX Ctrl-C while subagents are running now interrupts only the subagents, instead of exiting the whole CLI

entry.title: Kimi Code v0.43.0 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /sessions — Ctrl-X then y deletes the selected session from the picker
  • ADD kimi upgrade / kimi update — -y, --yes skips the confirmation prompt and installs directly
  • ADD loop_control.compaction_max_attempts — caps total attempts for a failing compaction request; default 5
  • ADD KIMI_CODE_PERMISSION_MODE_REMINDER env var — set to 0 to stop injecting auto permission-mode reminders into the model context
  • CHG Ctrl-S — a steering message can now interrupt a wait for a background task
  • CHG /goal — the time budget no longer counts time spent with the session closed, and the 24-hour limit is removed
